meta.description: A café in the former Turnov railway station building. Hearty breakfasts, a daily lunch menu, 15 kinds of coffee, homemade cakes. Nádražní 1118, Turnov.

home.heroSubtitle: A café in the former station building. Breakfast, lunch, coffee and cake — on the day's timetable.
home.breakfastText: Hearty breakfasts to start the journey, served throughout opening hours.
home.coffeeText: 15 kinds of coffee, to stay or to go. Plus draft beer from the Monopol brewery and homemade lemonades.
home.cakeText: Homemade cakes and pastries, fresh every day.
home.loungeText: A private room upstairs for celebrations, birthdays, business meetings and press conferences.

menuPage.title: LUNCH MENU
menuPage.description: The daily lunch menu is published on Facebook and on menicka.cz. This page has our permanent offer and opening hours.
menuPage.coffeeText: 15 kinds, espresso and filter, to stay or to go.

menuLinks.note: We publish the menu every morning.

about.title: ABOUT US
about.description: CAFE DEPO is a café in the former Turnov railway station building, run by sisters Pavla Linková and Eliška Konejlová.
about.lead: A café in the former Turnov railway station building, run by sisters Pavla Linková and Eliška Konejlová.
about.body1: Hearty breakfasts, a daily lunch menu, and fifteen kinds of coffee — DEPO works both as a stop along the way and as a destination in itself. Homemade cakes, pastries and lemonades are available, on the terrace or to go.
about.body2: Besides the ground-floor café, we offer an upstairs lounge — for celebrations, birthdays, business meetings and press conferences.
about.ownersText: Sisters Pavla Linková and Eliška Konejlová.
